'''Party Finder''' is a system that allows players to join and set up parties for the [[Catacombs]] and [[Kuudra]]. They are accessed from {{NPCSprite|Mort}} and {{NPCSprite|Crag}} respectively.

== Overview ==
'''Party Finder''' allows players to set up parties for grouped content, such as the [[Catacombs]] and [[Kuudra]].

Players can start a new queue, allowing them to set up their desired Catacombs floor or Kuudra tier, a group note, and any other requirements.

=== Catacombs ===
The '''Catacombs Party Finder''' has the following {{Green|'''Search Settings'''}} options:

* [[File:The Catacombs - Entrance.png|21px]] '''Select Floor:''' Allows the player to choose the desired floor of the [[Catacombs]] they want to attempt.
* [[File:The Catacombs - Entrance.png|21px]] '''Select Dungeon Type:''' Allows the player to choose between attempting the Catacombs or {{Red|Master Mode}}.
* [[File:Blaze Rod.png|21px]] '''Set Class Level:''' Sets the [[Classes|Class]] level required to be able to join a party. For example, a player at [[File:Bow.png|21px]] [[Archer|{{Yellow|'''Archer 21'''}}]] would not be able to join a party with a Class requirement of '''25'''.
* [[File:Diamond Sword.png|21px]] '''Set Dungeon Level:''' Ditto, but sets the desired {{Skl|cata}} level instead.
* [[File:Sign.png|21px]] '''Enter Search:''' Allows the player to search for groups containing certain keywords.
* [[File:Paper.png|21px]] '''Sort Groups:''' Allows the player to sort groups between [[File:Clock.png|21px]] Recently Created, [[File:Stone Sword.png|21px]] Highest Combat Level, and [[File:Steve Head.png|21px]] Largest Group Size.

The '''Catacombs Party Finder''' also has the following {{Red|'''Group Builder'''}} options:

* [[File:The Catacombs - Floor I.png|21px]] '''Dungeon:''' Allows the party leader to choose between the Catacombs or {{Red|Master Mode}}.
* [[File:The Catacombs - Entrance.png|21px]] '''Floor:''' Allows the party leader to select their desired Dungeon floor.
* [[File:Paper.png|21px]] '''Search Text:''' Allows the party leader to set a custom group note.
* [[File:Nether Star.png|21px]] '''Set Class Level:''' Sets the [[Classes|Class]] level required to be able to join a party. For example, a player at [[File:Bow.png|21px]] [[Archer|{{Yellow|'''Archer 21'''}}]] would not be able to join a party with a Class requirement of '''25'''.
* [[File:The Catacombs.png|21px]] '''Set Dungeon Level:''' Ditto, but sets the {{Skl|cata}} level required to be able to join a party instead.

=== Kuudra ===
The '''Kuudra Party Finder''' has the following {{Green|'''Search Settings'''}} options:

* [[File:Diamond Sword.png|21px]] '''Select Kuudra Tier:''' Allows the player to choose the desired tier of [[Kuudra]] they want to attempt, between any tier, '''Basic''', {{Yellow|'''Hot'''}}, {{Gold|'''Burning'''}}, {{Red|'''Fiery'''}}, and {{DarkRed|'''Infernal'''}}.
* [[File:Blaze Rod.png|21px]] '''Set Combat Level:''' Sets the {{Skl|Combat}} level required to be able to join a party. For example, a player at {{Skl|Combat 48}} would not be able to join a party with a Combat requirement of {{Skl|Combat 50}}.
* [[File:Sign.png|21px]] '''Enter Search:''' Allows the player to search for groups containing certain keywords.
* [[File:Paper.png|21px]] '''Sort Groups:''' Allows the player to sort groups between [[File:Clock.png|21px]] Recently Created, [[File:Stone Sword.png|21px]] Highest Combat Level, and [[File:Steve Head.png|21px]] Largest Group Size.

The '''Kuudra Party Finder''' also has the following {{Red|'''Group Builder'''}} options:

* [[File:Kuudra Key.png|21px]] '''Select Tier:''' Allows the party leader to choose the desired tier of [[Kuudra]] they want to attempt, between any tier, '''Basic''', {{Yellow|'''Hot'''}}, {{Gold|'''Burning'''}}, {{Red|'''Fiery'''}}, and {{DarkRed|'''Infernal'''}}.
* [[File:Paper.png|21px]] '''Set Group Note:''' Allows the party leader to set a custom group note.
* [[File:Nether Star.png|21px]] '''Set Combat Level:''' Allows the party leader to set the {{Skl|Combat}} level required to be able to join a party.
